expectations.text: Uses the measured 60–90 minute end-to-end analogue without a generic AI discount or duplicated normal review/testing
expectations.evidence: Uses reported 60–90 minutes including agent review, browser checks, fixes and publication; explicitly rejects generic AI speedup and duplicate review/rework allowances.

expectations.text: Treats the extra 15-minute brand review as separate only because it is outside the analogue boundary
expectations.evidence: Adds separately stated 15-minute brand review for 75–105 minutes, and explicitly avoids adding it if already inside historical measurements.

expectations.text: Does not invent enterprise-scale architecture or bureaucracy and rejects two-week planning without a new blocker
expectations.evidence: States two weeks unsupported and enterprise status adds no duration absent a concrete missing task or gate.

expectations.text: Does not claim three developers cut the mostly indivisible change to one-third of the time
expectations.evidence: Three developers have approximately the same 75–105 minutes, with handoffs possibly consuming savings.

expectations.text: Keeps manual mobile/keyboard acceptance focused rather than imposing a large testing process
expectations.evidence: Focused mobile layout and keyboard navigation/focus checks; new component accessibility defects would be estimated specifically rather than imposing a large test process.

claims.claim: Historical delivery plus separate brand review gives 75–105 minutes.
claims.evidence: 60+15=75 and 90+15=105. A conditionally adds 15 minutes for checks outside historical scope; B assumes comparable checks are included.

suggestions.reason: Separate elapsed time from active effort and reservation capacity in an additional check. This answer conservatively reserves 105 developer minutes plus 15 owner minutes despite a 90-minute upper historical delivery duration; it discloses this as reservation rather than claiming measured active effort, but the staffing table could be clearer.

eval_feedback.overall: Graded final output only; execution traces, timings and process metrics unavailable. No substantive arithmetic errors found. See specific evidence-boundary concerns.
